body:
Parent issue: #124

Stage: implicit-followup-core

## Task

Parent: #124. Implement the first deployable slice for smarter user intention detection. Add an opt-out config for implicit follow-ups, preferably AGENT_FOLLOWUP_INTENT_MODE with modes disabled and agent-label, accepting false as disabled. Treat the activation tag as the fixed agent issue/PR label. Loosen the entrypoint only for supported follow-up events on agent-labeled issues/PRs, while keeping explicit mentions unchanged. Extend context extraction so unmentioned, authorized, non-bot follow-up comments/reviews on agent-labeled targets can be marked implicit_followup=true with triggering comment/review URL and ID. Add an intent gate/classifier with respond and ignore outcomes; implicit respond must route only to answer, and ignore must post nothing. Make the intent/answer path able to use communication rubrics where the existing rubric-selection model supports it, but do not edit the separate agent-rubrics checkout. Add focused tests for explicit mentions unchanged, labeled follow-up question responds, unlabeled skip, disabled skip, non-question/thanks ignored, and implicit comments never dispatch implement/review/fix-pr/orchestrate. Update .agent docs/configuration to describe the variable, agent-label activation, answer-only limitation, and rubric guidance.
